8️⃣ Feeling Sick? Do This:
🤧Isolate yourself to prevent spread. 
🛌Rest and stay hydrated.
🌡️Monitor your symptoms.
💊Use over-the-counter meds for fever and pain.
👩‍⚕️If symptoms worsen, visit a doctor immediately.
